fact_text: Investors without a bank account cannot open a stock market account, because all payments must flow through the investor's own bank account in their name, and third-party cheques are not allowed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: A brokerage's KYC and customer due diligence require the client's source of income and wealth statement, which investors often find intrusive and which the interviewee said holds back investor base growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: The interviewee said the brokerage industry, if fully documented, regulated, free of cash and third-party cheques, and with traceable transactions, should be allowed simplified due diligence in line with international FATF guidance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: NCCPL holds a licence as a Central KYC Organisation, a role meant to collect customer information in the industry and pass it to regulators and government authorities when they need it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: The interviewee said the brokerage industry asks authorities for a holistic review of the stock market KYC framework, because the current process limits investor base growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: Under the capital gains tax regime, the tax treatment of a gain depends on the holding period of the shares, so a stable, long-term tax policy lets investors know their tax before they sell.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: The interviewee said that any public discussion of reviewing the capital gains tax regime causes market panic, dries up trading volumes, and needs groundwork to keep listed companies motivated.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: The interviewee said a small tax credit once given to listed companies has been discontinued, and argued that listed and private limited companies should face different tax rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: Companies first listed before 2016 were treated under section 37A for capital gains tax, while companies listed from 2016 onward had sponsors served notices to move to normal tax, which a 2020 measure only partly addressed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: The interviewee said the tax treatment of sponsor shares sold in IPO book-building differs across three groups: listings before 2016, listings from 2016 to 2020, and listings after 2020.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)

fact_text: The interviewee said a clarification proposed in the upcoming budget would set a uniform capital gains treatment from the first day of listing, with a policy-level commitment to address similar concerns in future.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'New Records But Low Participation — What's Wrong with Pakistan's Stock Market | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-22)
